verdict: 9 of the top 15 SHAP-ranked composition features have a documented connection to known ABX3 perovskite photovoltaic physics (ionic-radius/tolerance-factor proxies, electronegativity mismatch, valence-electron/bandgap proxies). The remainder (atomic weight, Mendeleev number, elemental ground-state space group/magnetic moment) have no established mechanistic interpretation in this context and most likely act as coarse element-identity proxies in the model.
